ModMetaData.name: NVIDIA GPU Monitor
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
NVIDIA GPU Monitor Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/archdukejim/NVIDIA-Tool/wiki
A standalone, in-game GPU toolkit for RimWorld. It renders your NVIDIA GPU's health, VRAM usage, and hardware telemetry directly inside RimWorld's UI — no external programs or overlays needed.
This is a general-purpose tool. It has no dependency on any other mod. It is especially handy if you run a local LLM alongside RimWorld (LM Studio, and mods such as RimTalk or the RimSynapse suite), but the GPU monitoring works for anyone with an NVIDIA card.
--- Core Systems --- - Live GPU Monitoring: Reads NVIDIA GPU stats via NVML (nvml.dll, part of every NVIDIA driver) in real time. Displays VRAM usage, GPU temperature, utilization, power draw, clocks, and fan speed. No process spawning — direct native calls, fully Workshop-safe. - VRAM Breakdown: A measured/estimated split of VRAM consumption — System/desktop, RimWorld itself, and (optionally) a local LM Studio model — so you can see exactly where your GPU memory is going. - VRAM Warnings: A proactive on-load advisory when your GPU is approaching its VRAM limit, with practical suggestions. - In-Game Overlay HUD: A toggleable on-screen overlay with GPU stats. Cycle Off → Basic (VRAM) → LM Studio → Developer (full hardware). - Developer Tools Window: A dashboard with GPU hardware stats and, when enabled, LM Studio status.
--- Optional: Local LLM (LM Studio) Awareness --- - Off by default. Enable it in mod settings and point it at your LM Studio endpoint (default http://localhost:1234). - When enabled and reachable, the tool reads the loaded model name directly from LM Studio's own HTTP API and estimates its VRAM footprint from the parameter count. A remote LM Studio host is detected and never counted against local VRAM. - This does NOT require RimSynapse, RimTalk, or any other mod — it talks to LM Studio directly.
--- Toolbar Integration --- - A toolbar button (bottom-right play settings row) toggles the GPU overlay.
--- Default Settings (adjustable in-game) --- Overlay: Off (toggle the on-screen GPU HUD) Show VRAM status on game load: On (uncheck to only warn when VRAM is critically low) LM Studio awareness: Off (opt-in; set your endpoint to enable)
--- Compatibility --- - Royalty / Ideology / Biotech / Anomaly DLC: Compatible. - Safe to add or remove from any save — the mod keeps zero save-file footprint (no GameComponent). - Runs happily alongside GPU/VRAM features in other mods; when a mod that ships its own VRAM advisory is active, this tool steps aside from the duplicate on-load popup and keeps the overlay and hardware readouts.
--- Requirements --- - Harmony (loaded before this mod). - An NVIDIA GPU with a current driver (nvml.dll is present automatically). On machines without an NVIDIA driver the tool stays quiet and simply reports that GPU advisories are unavailable.
--- Note --- This tool is optional and purely diagnostic. It does not affect gameplay.
